The noble gases are a group of elements found in Group 18 of the periodic table, known for their low reactivity due to having full valence electron shells. These gases are colorless and odorless under standard conditions. Among the various noble gases, one is particularly recognized for its low density and non-reactive nature. This gas is frequently utilized in various applications, including filling inflatable items, as it provides a lighter-than-air quality that allows such objects to float. While there are several noble gases, each with unique properties and uses, the specific one most commonly associated with this application is often selected for its safety and effectiveness in creating buoyancy.
